scope.purpose: Resolve the stale BTE-022 claim that Bar is not admitted by proving the binary-option Bar catalog projection/read-back path.

mapping_decision.decision: The BTE-compatible ParquetDataCatalog path for binary-option Bar data is source-fenced through a Rust projection/read-back test using CatalogInstrumentSpec::BinaryOption. This resolves the stale Bar-not-admitted conflict, but it does not select Kalshi, accept a source proof, or prove raw Kalshi candlestick normalization.
mapping_decision.bte_022_conflict_resolved: Bar is no longer a rejected BTE data class; run_manifest.rs admits Bar as the primary TradeBarReplay input.
remaining_limitations: Kalshi official historical data still needs accepted source proof evidence before use as canonical backfill input.
The staged catalog proof starts from a canonical Bar table; raw Kalshi candlestick normalization remains separate evidence.
PMXT broad Polymarket L2 backfill remains blocked by durable-source, coverage/cost, dynamic tick-size replay, and broad-backfill efficiency evidence.
